name: Everyone Is Important
overview: Scripture reveals that every person holds intrinsic value as God created mankind in His own image, granting them dominion over the earth (Genesis 1:26). God's intimate care extends even to the smallest sparrow, emphasizing His personal concern for all (Matthew 10:29). This divine love is demonstrated supremely in the gift of His Son, offering eternal life to everyone who believes (John 3:16). Jesus further clarifies that He alone is the way to the Father, underscoring the importance of each individual coming to faith (John 14:6; Matthew 28:19).
